## Live browser event mechanism

**Server-Sent Events (SSE)** over `GET /api/v1/sse`.

| Layer | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Route registration | `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` | `RegisterSSERoutes` → `handleSSE` |
| Connection handler | `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` | Auth via Bearer token, `text/event-stream`, subscribe/unsubscribe, 30s heartbeats |
| Hub | `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` | `SSEHub` — client registry, visibility-scoped fan-out, non-blocking `Broadcast` |
| Event builders | `server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go` | `buildMemoReactionSSEEvent`, `resolveSSECreatorID` |
| Wiring | `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` | `NewSSEHub()`, `RegisterSSERoutes(gwGroup, s.SSEHub, ...)` |

**Client:** `web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts` — `fetch("/api/v1/sse")`, parses `data:` JSON, invalidates React Query caches. Initialized from `web/src/main.tsx`.

**Event types:** `memo.created`, `memo.updated`, `memo.deleted`, `memo.comment.created`, `reaction.upserted`, `reaction.deleted`

---

## Hub implementation

**`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`** — `SSEHub`, `SSEClient`, `SSEEvent`, `NewSSEHub()`, `Subscribe`, `Unsubscribe`, `Broadcast`, `Close`

## Memo RPC handlers that broadcast

### Direct (`s.SSEHub.Broadcast(...)` in handler)

| Handler | File | Event |
|---|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.created` *(skipped when `isSSESuppressed(ctx)` — e.g. internal call from `CreateMemoComment`)* |
| `DeleteMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.deleted` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` | `memo.comment.created` |
| `UpsertMemoReaction` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` | `reaction.upserted` *(via `buildMemoReactionSSEEvent`)* |
| `DeleteMemoReaction` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` | `reaction.deleted` *(via `buildMemoReactionSSEEvent`)* |

### Indirect (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `SSEHub.Broadcast`, `memo.updated`)

Helper: **`dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`** in `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:66`

| Handler | File | Helper chain |
|---|---|---|
| `UpdateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:513` | `buildUpdatedMemoState` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:48` | `touchMemoUpdatedTimestamp` → `buildUpdatedMemoState` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:48` | `touchMemoUpdatedTimestamp` → `buildUpdatedMemoState` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` |

## Notes

- **`CreateMemoComment`** calls `CreateMemo` with `withSuppressSSE(ctx)` so only `memo.comment.created` fires, not `memo.created`.
- **`CreateMemo`** may call `setMemoAttachmentsInternal` / `setMemoRelationsInternal` inline, but those helpers do **not** broadcast; only the dedicated `SetMemo*` RPC handlers go through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`.
